# AG Grid Community

Vendored from `ag-grid-community@36.2.0` (MIT), installed with the root npm lockfile.
The bundled script includes styles and is served locally for an offline demo.

SHA-256: `5f8ddee2e7e2d78e4005f29329404e67bba54ee6db63710b91878e81076ebc1e`

To refresh, install the pinned package and copy `dist/ag-grid-community.min.js`
and `LICENSE.txt` from `node_modules/ag-grid-community`.

[Official JavaScript quick start](https://www.ag-grid.com/javascript-data-grid/getting-started/)
